2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore’s interior absence gives Indianapolis a protection-first path
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: Baltimore opens the Jesse Minter era without defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike, creating an interior opportunity for Indianapolis as it tries to keep its offense on schedule. The Colts enter without anyone ruled out, and Alec Pierce progressed through the week after a heel issue. Lamar Jackson still forces Indianapolis to defend every blade of grass, so the Colts cannot let manageable downs become scramble-driven explosives. Protection discipline, third-down containment and Baltimore’s ability to replace interior disruption should shape the opener.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore owns the stronger quarterback-driven ceiling, but Indianapolis can narrow the game by protecting its passer, sustaining early-down efficiency and preventing Jackson from extending drives outside structure.
